title.narrative: Towards Coherent and Inclusive Governance of Palestinian Camps in Lebanon: Support Project to the Lebanese Palestinian Dialogue Committee

description.narrative:
The overall objective of this initiative is to support LPDC in finalizing a comprehensive and sustainable rights based National Policy Framework for Palestinian Camp Governance through evidence generation, structured consultations, and institutional accompaniment.
Impact: The National Policy Framework on Palestinian Camp Governance is finalized and institutionalized for transition to the next government.
Outcomes: 1. LPDC’s capacity to manage dialogue, data, and policy processes is strengthened, enabling sustained coordination with national and international development partners. 2. A consolidated evidence base on Palestinian camps is established to inform the development and implementation of the National Policy Framework. 3. Palestinian perspectives are documented, providing a foundation for more legitimate and responsive governance approaches. 4. A technically and politically sound roadmap for digital identification is developed under Lebanese leadership, setting the stage for implementation.
Outputs: 1.1- National Consultation and Policy Process 2.1- Data consolidation and Camp profiling 3.1: Insights into Community Perceptions and Expectations 4.1- Digital Identification Roadmap
